versions.content: The “Further action” byte of a vehicle identification response/vehicle announceme nt message shall contain the 1 Byte value retrieved by a call to the configured DoIPFurtherActionByteCallback (if configured, for the signature see <User>_DoIPGetFurtherAc tionByteCallback, SWS_DoIP_00288 ). If the function returns E_OK, the “Further action” byte shall be set to the retrieved value of FurtherActionByte. If the function returns E_NOT_OK, the “Further action” byte shall be set according to [SWS_DoIP_00082], [SWS_DoIP_00083] or [SWS_DoIP_00084].
